outputComponents.text:
I have designed and delivered the mobile `/requests` page for the Setup Owner role in the PSF Request Portal redesign project (Screen `PSF Request Portal — Requests (Mobile Setup Owner)`), strictly adhering to your specifications and **DESIGN.md**:

### Highlights of the Implementation:

1. **Purpose & Scoped Catalog View**
   - **Header**: Features the exact title `Requests` and supporting sentence *"Browse shared PSF requests."* alongside the clarifying note *"• Private drafts are in My Drafts"* linking directly to `/my-drafts`.
   - **Shared Catalog Scope**: Displays shared submitted work without copying Dashboard count tiles, scopes, or invented assignment actions.

2. **Setup Owner Shell & Navigation**
   - **Header & Mobile Drawer**: Includes a top menu toggle (44×44px touch target) opening a sliding navigation drawer with an accessible close button.
   - **Navigation Routes**: Contains `Dashboard` (`/dashboard`), `Requests` (`/requests` — active with leading brand indicator), `My Drafts` (`/my-drafts`), and `Audit History` (`/history`).
   - **Role Restrictions**: `Export` and `Admin` tools are excluded for the Setup Owner role.
   - **User Profile**: Configured as fictional **Alex Morgan**, `Setup Owner · MFG` with avatar initials `AM`.
   - **Primary Action**: "New Request" button linking to `/requests/new`.

3. **Toolbar & Read-Only Filter Controls**
   - **Persistent Search**: Visible search input with placeholder *"Search request no., title, PSF or probecard"*.
   - **Collapsible Filters Disclosure**: Accessible "Filters" toggle button opening without page overflow to reveal:
     - **Status Select**: Contains `All statuses` and all **16 non-draft catalog options** decoded with exact spelling, spacing, and backslash intact (including the full 71-character `93% -- Provide test template map to EWFM\Update auto FI script (ST Fab)`).
     - **Product Type Text Input**: Plain text filter input.
     - **Clear Filters**: One-click filter reset action.

4. **Five Fictional Illustrative Rows & Data Representation**
   - Rendered as vertical cards optimized for mobile viewports (390px) without horizontal table clipping:
     1. **PSF-2026-0042**: *S32K3 probe layout update* | `New Product` | `20% -- PSF File Creating` (open kind icon) | `01 Oct 2026` (`OVERDUE`, `High`) | Alex Morgan / Mei Tan · MFG
     2. **PSF-2026-0039**: *ST Fab template map review* | `Transfer Product` | Full `93%` status string wrapped cleanly | `06 Oct 2026` (`Normal`) | Priya Rao / Rowan Miller · GNTC
     3. **PSF-2026-0035**: *Wafer map site verification* | `Existing Product` | `99% -- Wait requestor Buyoff site location and wafer map` (open kind icon) | `08 Oct 2026` (`Normal`) | Alex Morgan / Mei Tan · MFG
     4. **PSF-2026-0028**: *Probe pattern release* | `New Product` | `100% -- Completed` (completed kind green badge) | `02 Oct 2026` (`Normal`) | Jordan Lee / Rowan Miller · GNTC
     5. **PSF-2026-0019**: *Cancelled layout request* | `Existing Product` | `0% -- Rejected (Cancel Request)` (cancelled kind slate badge) | `09 Oct 2026` (`Normal`) | Priya Rao / Mei Tan · MFG
   - Each card provides a 44px link affordance to `/requests/<id>`.

5. **Client-side Interactivity & Theme Toggle**
   - **Theme Toggle**: Accessible button in the header labeled `"Switch to dark mode"` / `"Switch to light mode"`, toggling `data-theme` on the root element. Uses NXP-inspired dark surface tones (`#101B24`, `#1A2C39`) with legible contrast across badges, inputs, and drawers.
   - **Footer & Pagination**: Retains the single sample page footer (`Showing 1–5 of 5 requests`, `Page 1 of 1`, disabled Previous/Next) and includes an empty state when filters match zero records.
